hypothesis: Replace only the exact nonempty MCE namespace-presence byte-window search with existing memchr::memmem::find; avoid repeated comparisons while preserving all parser and resource-limit behavior.

allocation.scope: Unchanged harness commit and publication counters; namespace predicate has no allocations. Diagnostic only; planning allocations not isolated.

profile.scope: Exact-name method capture; uniquely identify measured caller edge, retain lifecycle and termination dumps. No latency conversion.

admission: Require primary total p50 and mean reduction at least 1%, and planning p50 reduction at least 2%, in both repeats of both shapes. Require planning Ir reduction at least 1% in each profile if native pilot passes. Review every greater than 5% adverse metric and absolute same-build drift individually. Allocation diagnostics must show no unexplained regression. Shared DOCX/PPTX guards and full applicable quality gates required. Reject if native pilot fails. No cold/range/native-producer/scaling claim.
native_order: retained baseline native-r2 under candidate source checkout
retained_baseline_custody: Retained baseline binary and build manifest remain hash-bound; candidate checkout source is independently bound during final A2 and differs only in the frozen candidate file inventory.
resource_scope: Byte predicate only; same input/output limits, borrowed no-MCE result, raw presence semantics and full MCE parser.

hardware.scope: Whole fresh child including corpus/setup/publication/oracles; diagnostic only, not isolated commit counters.

candidate_source_binding: Exact source file inventory and SHA256 values captured independently for each stage; candidate diff must be nonempty and entirely within candidate_source_roots. Harness source is identical. Review exact production/test patch before application.

conditional_lanes.profile: Required for retention only after pilot gates pass; preserved baseline binaries may run under candidate checkout.
conditional_lanes.hardware: Diagnostic only after pilot gates pass.
conditional_lanes.eager: Required before retention; no primary gain claim.
